category_title: Low-attaining students developing fraction concepts through physical measurement with manipulatives
scenario_title: Connecting physical measurement to fraction names
minimal_context: The student is using red and brown Cuisenaire rods to determine fraction names during a mathematics lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please use these red and brown Cuisenaire rods to work on your fractions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Places the red rods beside the brown rod) What it is. I'm kind of measuring it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you trying to measure?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: See if it's a quarter or not. Because I went like this... (moves small red rods along the longer rod).

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How would you know if it is a quarter?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: An ordinary guess. I was happy because that was pretty easy until I got up to number 6, 'cause I knew it all. Now I need you to tell me the parts.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please use these red and brown Cuisenaire rods to work on your fractions.

STUDENT: (Places the red rods beside the brown rod) What it is. I'm kind of measuring it.

TUTOR: What are you trying to measure?

STUDENT: See if it's a quarter or not. Because I went like this... (moves small red rods along the longer rod).

TUTOR: How would you know if it is a quarter?

STUDENT: An ordinary guess. I was happy because that was pretty easy until I got up to number 6, 'cause I knew it all. Now I need you to tell me the parts.

task.content: A lesson on fractions that used Cuisenaire rods
task.learning_goal: Scaffolding the concept that the number of parts in one whole names the fraction

context.materials: Cuisenaire rods (specifically red rods and brown rods)
context.social_setting: Working individually or in pairs while the teacher walks around
context.time_context: Over the course of a lesson in 'chunks'

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked 'How would you know if it is a quarter?'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Responded that it was 'An ordinary guess'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Felt happy because it was 'pretty easy' until he got up to number 6, where he needed help
related_quotes: I was happy because that was pretty easy until I got up to number 6, ‘cause I knew it all. Ms B helped me a little bit. She told me the parts.

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked 'What are you checking to see?'
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Described physical actions rather than mathematical concepts, stating 'I'm kind of measuring it' and moving small red rods along the longer rod
related_quotes: What it is. I’m kind of measuring it.
